meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
If your budget is **₹3,000 in India, I'd shortlist Decathlon, Puma, and Adidas first**\. You can get a decent pair for beginner and recreational running without spending more. My main advice is to prioritise actual running comfort and fit over the brand name or looks.

## My top picks under ₹3,000

![Men Running Shoes Superior Grip Cushioned Upto 20km/week, Jogflow 190.1 - Grey](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/FJ2ity97YnZshE02klEfW2gBskt9yL4NaRzVZab39r9guxwrv9isCxxVOUlNaLaK9ZM7IEURC_S9bFBSMhLLf7-JbRjpl5Xau-ycCntrDaTRQESu6_QOOgAtVr4uhr4eTkHMMzKX8xd7skFjhJzpfYNF9o2TuMFWGd_tMiFwb91ihZg36IDT-x1dfzOxwTFD?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Decathlon Jogflow 190.1

Best value for beginners

### ₹1,699

Listed price at Decathlon

A sensible choice for easy runs, jogging and regular training. It leaves you money for running socks, too.

Best for: starting out and running a few times per week.

[Shop at Decathlon](https://www.decathlon.in/shop/decathlon-running) [www.decathlon.in](https://www.decathlon.in/shop/decathlon-running?SPMID=RE2lt3eXB4Z8RD7PpJVVUw)

---

![Sapatilha Puma Skyrocket Lite 311730 Preto | Grupo SAROS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LuGNPzwqe2nHkHjjWjvpARoZTiTpgO92ipOpdXalthaiTxxah9nIdijkVXNvbGVRPcljX5cC_S27LeRCEgTbgfaTGn3RWj7amDI6yx_Zn2Jz1oj06UdlqVHGogieDQidAM-BDoF0Ofg6ZZ1BbVfPE0XstSd3d1QqXmueKmNPQ2MRHN-fzisq6xF2-uMYyWmr?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. PUMA Skyrocket Lite

Best branded alternative

### ₹2,999

Listed price on PUMA India

Worth trying if you prefer a major sportswear brand and want a shoe for running as well as everyday wear.

Best for: road jogging and general fitness.

[Shop at PUMA India](https://in.puma.com/in/en/shop/shoes-under-3000) [in.puma.com](https://in.puma.com/in/en/shop/shoes-under-3000)

---

![adidas RESTOUND SHOES - Black | adidas India](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KMTAslUTQ5O7D5L4IJZC1myxuF2Q_rrhVP5VIU08z3HSuiXo4406lggjVAtcAq6UGC6d197ypuRgM4K98M57idPWJqU-8rWuAT3coDx86KcIAc87C-RWSEK7y5q7ZbLYE8dQBoSInAZHvpn8Fqz69nB-WrSQT85I-usbMLTsGKjTyu6pfsp5D0vylr7AHSE5?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Adidas Restound

Budget everyday option

### ₹1,800

Listed price on Adidas India

A budget-friendly option if you want Adidas branding and a versatile shoe. Compare the fit and cushioning with the Decathlon before choosing it for regular runs.

Best for: light jogging and mixed everyday use.

[Shop at Adidas India](https://www.adidas.co.in/shoes_under_3000-running) [www.adidas.co.in](https://www.adidas.co.in/shoes_under_3000-running)

Prices are online listings checked for this comparison and may change with size, colour and sales. The shoes above are candidates to try, not a claim that one will fit everyone best.

## Which one should you actually buy?

- **For occasional 2–3 km runs\:** Decathlon Jogflow 190.1.
- **For a branded option near ₹3,000\:** PUMA Skyrocket Lite.
- **For running plus casual wear\:** Adidas Restound, provided the fit feels good.

Before buying, try them on and leave roughly a thumb's width of space in front of your longest toe. If you plan to run 5 km or more regularly, comfort over repeated runs matters more than the discount.

Decathlon launches KIPRUN sub-brand in India to catch the 'running boom'; plans to reach 5 million runners by 2030
search_results.description: Decathlon India has launched its running-focused sub-brand, KIPRUN, aiming to capitalize on the growing popularity of running in the country. The company plans to build a business exceeding Rs 1,000 crore by 2030 and reach over 5 million active runners. Originally introduced globally in 2008, KIPRUN is now present in 70 countries. For its India launch, Decathlon has introduced 35 products under the running category, which includes running shoes, apparel, hydration packs, trail gear, and other accessories. Among these, 17 are performance running shoes, reflecting the brand's commitment to supporting both amateur and professional runners in India.
